$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md section 3 - feature scenario for CE-4629 / R-4280 (vehicle breaching, DESIGN_Vehicle_Breaching 7.8). Judge: (1) a car and a tank end beyond the 10 cm kerb, a car at the 1 m garden wall stays south of it; (2) after an AI dozer (TKB 112, ClearObstacle with a point on the wall) stands at a 2 m free wall that spans the range (so nothing walks round it) a rifleman ordered through the cut AND a second one ordered 2 m aside both arrive; the same on a wall made of one-metre pieces (on this flat range a LineString with a vertex per metre gives one panel per segment - the same multi-panel case as a wall stepping with a slope); the two 'Probe' men, ordered through where nothing was cut, never get there (the walls are real); the same on bt-range's own 60 m fence row; (3) a rifleman ordered into House A's west room (its three doors Locked, as bd-destruction) arrives through the dozer's cut. LEFT OUT (grammar, section 9): a breach has no cue, so every cut is approximated by POSITIONS - 'the dozer stands at its wall' stands for 'the blade cut', a man arriving beyond for 'the gap is open'; the gap's WIDTH (>= 5.3 m) is shown only by the second man 2 m aside, not measured; the possessed player's bump is covered by rails (CarKinematicsSystemTests), not here. FIXED (was KNOWN RED at d16a3a3c8): the free walls' cuts were never re-baked on a live node - TerrainResidency.DirtyRegions gave a dirty box only to a BUILDING's damage, never to a free-wall line's group (CE-4599); fixed at 86b21b214 (rail BuildingDamageBakeTests.CE4629_AFreeWallCut_IsReBaked_OnAnIncrementalNode). NO golden (section 5, measured 2026-11-16 at 86b21b214): a capture then two fresh runs - one matched, one differed from t = 50 s in the riflemen crossing the cuts (every condition passed in all three). The navmesh re-bake that opens a cut is debounced on the WALL clock and runs off the frame thread (StaticObstacleBakeSystem, CE-4596 P-0), so the tick the gap opens differs between runs. Re-try a golden once the bake commits on sim time.
